source.title: Volatility-scaled trend filters for futures
source.text:
We study a volatility-scaled trend filter on 12 liquid futures markets from 2005 to 2020.

The filter divides the 20-day price change by the 20-day standard deviation of daily returns. A trade is allowed only when the filter is above a threshold, which we tune per market.

The filter uses daily closing prices.

Adding the filter to a simple breakout system raised the Sharpe ratio from 0.6 to 0.9 after costs.

The filter fails in choppy years such as 2015, when it cut winning trades as often as losing ones.
